Large bold black Chinese characters are centered at the top of the frame. (2) The perspective shifts to a side-angled close-up of the cat's rounded, bread-like body segments. The orange stripes are prominent against the white fur. The background remains a stark, minimalist white environment. No text is visible in this specific frame except the bottom copyright mark at the base. (3) The scene returns to the initial framing of the cat under the blanket. Several black 'z' characters of varying sizes float upwards from the cat's head in a diagonal line, indicating deep sleep. The cat remains completely motionless, suggesting a state of rest in a minimalist room.
